body.message:
Hello Rachel,

We would like to inform you that, to secure and confirm the booking for 12 months, the first month’s rent, last month’s rent, and security deposit will need to be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we can reserve the unit and guarantee the agreed rate for the confirmed booking period.

The remaining months can be paid on a monthly basis.

Please allow me some time to check the rate for a 12-month booking, and I will update you shortly.

Unfortunately, we do not have a video or floor plan available for this unit. However, we can arrange a self-viewing for you if you would like to view the apartment in person.

Thank you for your understanding.
